layout_map:
1. Slide number badge — top-right corner (yellow circle with "31")
2. Main title — top-center ("Most Common Kernel Functions", dark red, largest text)
3. Four kernel definition cards — stacked vertically, center-left to center-right; each has a red title, blue/purple border, and formula content:
   - Linear Kernel
   - Quadratic Kernel
   - Polynomial Kernel (of degree "d")
   - Radial Basis Function (RBF) Kernel
4. Math notation — inside each card; variables in red, connector words ("or", "No Mapping") in dark gray/black
5. Small unlabeled icon — inside RBF card, between formula and right-side annotation
6. Bottom black band — full-width black strip along the bottom edge (approx. bottom 8% of frame)
7. Thin reddish outer frame — hairline border enclosing the slide content area
first_glance_test: A brand-new user understands within 3 seconds that this is a reference slide listing four common SVM kernel functions with their mathematical formulas. The screen offers zero interactive actions — it is a static information display, and nothing on it looks clickable. Given the injected VIEW purpose (lecture frame), the focal point should be the kernel formulas; the red main title wins the eye first, then the four red card titles draw the gaze downward in a clear top-to-bottom sequence. The focal point works as intended.
strengths: Four cards stacked vertically with identical borders and red titles make the four kernel types instantly scannable (cards 1–4).
Consistent color coding: all kernel titles and math variables use the same dark red; all card borders share the same blue/purple hue (cards 1–4).
Clear typographic hierarchy: main title is largest at top, card titles are second, formulas are third, connector words ("or", "No Mapping") are smallest and darkest (title area and cards).

defects.description: Linear Kernel card — right annotation — "No Mapping ," — space before comma breaks standard punctuation spacing — delete the space before the comma.
bottom band — full-width black strip at frame bottom — empty black strip reads as a cropped footer or dead void — populate with footer copy or remove the band.
RBF Kernel card — between formula and right annotation — small unlabeled icon floats with no container or label — it implies interactivity on a static slide — remove the icon or add a visible label.

top_3: Bottom black band — §4(h) — dead full-width strip reads as a cropped footer or void, the most visible anomaly on the slide.
Unlabeled icon — §4(k) — floating glyph implies false interactivity on a static slide, weakening trust in the frame's affordances.
Space before comma — §4(b) — punctuation error undercuts the professional polish of the mathematical copy.
structural_proposal: No structural moves recommended — the four-card vertical stack already matches the content's reading order, and any reorganization would reduce scannability.
uncertainties: Whether the bottom black band is OS window chrome (taskbar/dock) to be ignored per the capture rules, or part of the slide frame requiring a footer or removal.
Whether this light-themed slide is an exempt slide asset or in-app chrome breaking the app's documented dark-theme surface rules.
The exact identity of the small floating icon in the RBF card (pencil, cursor, or artifact) at this resolution.
